ai_summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited (AEL) has issued a regulatory filing intimating shareholders about its 41st Annual General Meeting (AGM) on September 8, 2026, via virtual means, and the proposed dividend of Re. 0.40 per share for FY26 (record date: September 1, 2026), with web-links provided for the Annual Report and AGM Notice. The material impacts for shareholders include the impending dividend distribution (subject to TDS) and a critical reminder to update KYC details to claim entitlements and prevent unclaimed funds/shares from being transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF). No specific financial red flags are present; this document primarily addresses routine corporate governance and shareholder communication requirements.
